title: Cyperenoic acid from Gentiana kurroo suppresses Melanogenesis via modulation of MITF without altering ERK and CREB phosphorylation, with predicted interaction at the MITF kink pocket.
authors: Matsuyoshi, Hiroko; Sato, Daisuke; Koketsu, Mamoru; Ninomiya, Masayuki; Kimura, Hirokazu; Myint, Lwin Mon Mon; Okada, Taichi; Satsu, Hideo; Shingu, Takashi; Hirano, Yoshiaki; Nishina, Atsuyoshi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物cyperenoic acid通过调控MITF抑制黑色素生成，虽含MITF分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: The ethyl acetate fraction of Gentiana kurroo was investigated to identify constituents responsible for anti-melanogenic activity. Among solvent-partitioned extracts evaluated in alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH)-stimulated B16 murine melanoma cells, the ethyl acetate fraction exhibited the strongest suppression of melanin production without apparent cytotoxicity. Six compounds previously isolated and structurally characterized by our group were re-evaluated, among which cyperenoic acid showed the most potent inhibitory effect, reducing melanin content to 56.3%, 45.1%, and 5.7% of the alpha-MSH-stimulated control at 10, 30, and 100 muM, respectively (IC(5)(0)  approximately  21 muM). Mechanistic studies revealed that cyperenoic acid significantly downregulated tyrosinase and tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP2) expression and attenuated phosphorylation of microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF). In contrast, phosphorylation levels of extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) and cAMP response element-binding protein (CREB), two major upstream regulators of MITF, were not significantly affected. These results suggest that cyperenoic acid suppresses melanogenesis through modulation of MITF phosphorylation independently of ERK and CREB signaling under the present conditions. Molecular docking analysis using the MITF bHLH-LZ domain indicated structural compatibility of cyperenoic acid with the MITF kink pocket, a recently proposed ligand-binding site. Collectively, these findings suggest that cyperenoic acid is a promising anti-melanogenic natural product acting via MITF modulation.
abstract_zh: 对龙胆（Gentiana kurroo）的乙酸乙酯部位进行了研究，以鉴定具有抗黑色素生成活性的成分。在α-黑素细胞刺激激素（alpha-MSH）刺激的B16小鼠黑色素瘤细胞中评估的溶剂分配提取物中，乙酸乙酯部位表现出最强的黑色素生成抑制作用，且无明显细胞毒性。我们课题组先前分离并结构鉴定的六种化合物被重新评估，其中cyperenoic acid显示出最有效的抑制效果，在10、30和100 μM浓度下，将黑色素含量分别降低至alpha-MSH刺激对照组的56.3%、45.1%和5.7%（IC(5)(0) 约 21 μM）。机制研究表明，cyperenoic acid显著下调酪氨酸酶和酪氨酸酶相关蛋白-2（TRP2）的表达，并减弱小眼畸形相关转录因子（MITF）的磷酸化。相比之下，细胞外信号调节激酶（ERK）和cAMP反应元件结合蛋白（CREB）——MITF的两个主要上游调控因子——的磷酸化水平未受到显著影响。这些结果表明，在现有条件下，cyperenoic acid通过调节MITF磷酸化抑制黑色素生成，且不依赖于ERK和CREB信号通路。使用MITF bHLH-LZ结构域的分子对接分析表明，cyperenoic acid与MITF扭结口袋（一种近期提出的配体结合位点）具有结构兼容性。综合来看，这些发现表明cyperenoic acid是一种通过MITF调节发挥作用的、有前景的抗黑色素生成天然产物。
